capabilities.title: Audio processing pipeline: noise reduction, enhancement, and format conversion
capabilities.sourceEvidence: The current README exposes on-device multilingual TTS; it does not claim a general noise-reduction, enhancement, or conversion toolkit.
capabilities.reason: Nexus is an intelligence dashboard with no audio processing lane. Audio pipeline tooling is outside product scope.

capabilities.title: Neural voice synthesis: text-to-speech with controllable pitch, pace, and style
capabilities.reason: The upstream announced archival and the model carries a separate OpenRAIL-M license. Nexus will not add an unsupported ONNX/model supply chain without a consent-aware voice surface and maintained dependency plan.

capabilities.title: Extract structured signals from audio: sentiment, topic, speaker diarization
capabilities.sourceEvidence: The current README exposes TTS inference and does not claim transcription, sentiment, topic extraction, or speaker diarization.
capabilities.reason: The inventoried signal-extraction claim is not supported by the current upstream. Nexus will not present a TTS model as an audio-intelligence analyzer.
